verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomed its first guests in 1867 and is known as the Grand Dame of Amsterdam.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since welcoming its first guests in 1867, this iconic riverside landmark has earned its title as the “Grand Dame” of Amsterdam.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits along the banks of the Amstel River in the heart of Amsterdam.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’ll find us in the heart of Amsterdam, along the banks of the Amstel River.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are appointed with Dutch period furniture, plush drapes, delicate wall patterns and handcrafted Delft blue pottery.
verified_facts.excerpt: exquisitely appointed with Dutch period furniture, plush drapes, delicate wall patterns, and handcrafted Delft blue pottery

verified_facts.text: The large heated indoor pool offers a river-level view of Amsterdam.
verified_facts.excerpt: The large heated indoor pool offers a unique river-level view of Amsterdam.

verified_facts.text: The Amstel Health & Fitness Club includes a sauna, steam cabin and Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: You also have access to the sauna, steam cabin, and Jacuzzi.

verified_facts.text: The Amstel Lounge sits beneath a dome with river views and is known for its seasonal afternoon tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Amstel Lounge, nestled beneath an enchanting dome with river views, exudes elegance that intertwines heritage and modernity. Renowned for its seasonal afternoon tea

verified_facts.text: The Amstel Restaurant overlooks the Amstel River and serves a Mediterranean-based menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Location: Located on level -1, overlooking the Amstel River.

verified_facts.text: The A Bar has one of the most extensive whisky collections in the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Having one of the most extensive whisky collections in the city, the A Bars cocktails have a spirit forward focus

verified_facts.text: Private historical saloon boats take guests from the hotel's quayside on tours of the UNESCO-listed Amsterdam canals.
verified_facts.excerpt: take you down to the quay side of the Hotel for a memorable tour through the UNESCO heritage listed Amsterdam canals. On our private historical saloon boats

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite, Champagne Suite and Penthouse suite may include a balcony and river view.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Champagne Suite may include:

- Balcony
- River View

verified_facts.text: Classic Rooms may include a river view or city view.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Classic Rooms may include:

- River View, City View

verified_facts.text: Babysitting and a nanny for hire are available.
Concierge can provide Anne Frank House tickets upon availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tip: Cut the queues by purchasing your tickets at the Concierge desk (upon availability).

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed, except certified guide dogs and service animals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed in the hotel, with the exception of certified Guide Dogs and Service Animals.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes it as a 19th-century hotel on the outer edge of the canal ring overlooking the Amstel, with a white-columned entrance and a lobby with marble floors and a vaulted ceiling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find this 19th-century hotel on the outer edge of the canal ring overlooking the Amstel. A walk through the white-columned entrance reveals a lobby with shiny marble floors and a vaulted ceiling.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the marble bathrooms include rainfall showers and a separate bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: The vast marble bathrooms include rainfall showers and separate bath and toilet.

verified_facts.text: The Rijksmuseum is about 2.5 kilometers from the hotel.
